decisive_items: Dilated left ventricle with end-diastolic dimension of 6.6 cm
response.rationale: Uremic cardiomyopathy is most consistent with ESKD on dialysis, dilated LV with reduced EF, and normal wall thickness; biopsy lacks lupus-specific or hypertensive hypertrophic changes.

rejected.why: Hypertensive heart disease typically shows LV hypertrophy with increased wall thickness; here wall thickness is normal and BP is only mildly elevated.
Lupus cardiomyopathy would show inflammatory or immune-mediated biopsy findings; biopsy is largely unremarkable and lacks lupus-specific changes.
